purpose: Route detected anomalies through bounded mitigation, sandbox self-test, hotfix qualification, hotswap/failover and rollback without allowing prediction or automation to manufacture authority.
invariants: human_dignity_privacy_child_safety_gates cannot be bypassed by technical score

risk_vector.score_rule: weighted evidence only; unknown dimensions remain TOKEN_VAZIO and never score as zero risk
risk_vector.tensor_note: vectors/tensors are semantic prioritization structures, not proof of causality

triggers.P0: immediate HOLD; no autonomous promotion; sandbox-only reproduction; require explicit authority and evidence before mutation
triggers.P1: bounded mitigation may proceed on non-authoritative branch with rollback point and canary
triggers.P2_P3: queue, observe and trend; promotion still requires ordinary gates

watchdog.loop_guard: max_attempts and cooldown required per route

allowed: fault injection into owned test fixtures

preconditions: data migration reversibility or explicit irreversible hold
rollback.automatic_allowed_only_when: pre-authorized, bounded, reversible, no privacy/protected-subject/legal authority ambiguity

predictive_layer.rule: forecast changes inspection priority; it never changes claim_allowed by itself

normative_matrix.certification_rule: reference to a law/standard/framework never implies certification
